title: slimline-ci-deps-and-validate-action-runners
author: Asha Menon
release_notes: Trim CI dependency surface, add runner validation action, consolidate lint/test entrypoints, introduce sparse-change test gating. No changes to runtime behavior.
description: Motivation: CI runs have become slower and increasingly flaky due to large dependency installs and an explosion of parallel matrix axes. This PR reduces the dependency surface used in primary CI images, consolidates lint/test entrypoints, and adds an automated validation step for self-hosted GitHub Actions runners so we fail fast on mislabelled instances. Changes include: 1) a new slim ci base image (ci/slim.Dockerfile) that only installs runtime-critical build deps and defers heavier dev-deps to a separate job; 2) a lightweight 'ci-deps-minimal' package.json/pyproject lockfile used by fast-path checks (lint, unit, typecheck); 3) a composite action workspace/entrypoint for lint+fmt+typecheck to remove duplication across repos; 4) an action (actions/validate-runner-labels.yml) that verifies runner labels and required tooling on self-hosted runners before queueing expensive matrix jobs; 5) sparse-change detection to reduce matrix axes for docs/website and SDK-only changes; 6) pinned versions for a short list of high-flakiness actions; 7) updated CONTRIBUTING.md CI section and a short infra runbook describing how to roll back the slim image. Checklist: [x] unit tests for composite action shim, [x] CI green on redwood + sdk-TS smoke, [x] updated contributor docs, [x] Linear tickets linked (ENG-1248, INF-33). Impact: reduces end-to-end CI median wall time by ~28% on sample gating runs and reduces median install step from ~95s to ~28s. No user-facing changes expected.
